host.label: Server
host.description: The hostname or IP address of the NFS server to connect to. For example mynas.local or 192.168.1.100.

export_path.label: Export path
export_path.description: The NFS export path on the remote server. For example /volume1/music or /exports/media.

subfolder.label: Subfolder
subfolder.description: [optional] Use if your music is stored in a sublevel of the export. E.g. 'collections' or 'albums/A-K'.

nfs_version.label: NFS Version
nfs_version.description: The NFS protocol version to use. Use Auto to let the system negotiate the best available version.

manifest.description: Play music and audiobooks stored on NFS connected network drives.

errors.invalid_subfolder: Invalid subfolder {0}: it must be a relative path inside the export.
errors.subfolder_not_found: Subfolder {0} does not exist in the NFS export.
